_doc: Files shipped in the Steam (card-only) package that may contain CJK characters outside data/cards/text/**, with the reason (CARDS_INTERFACES.md section 11.4 item 5).
Reasons must say why the characters are never shown to the player in the ship build. K15's audit.py fails on any other shipped file with CJK.
Comments in .gd files are stripped by the binary-token export (script_export_mode=2); string literals are not.
W0 initial list: legacy files the card engine reuses (read-only). Re-check when a task starts preloading another legacy file.

files.scripts/sim/item_gen.gd: ItemGen writes CJK item names/notes into its own item dicts; CardItems keeps only sanitized integer fields in state and shows item text from data/cards/text/items.text.json.
files.scripts/core/ledger.gd: Legacy ledger journal reasons and ticket ids are CJK; card_ledger.gd overrides open_pawn/redeem_amount/tick_contracts with ASCII ids and reason codes; journal text is never displayed in the card UI.
files.scripts/ui/style.gd: UiStyle is used only for fonts (body_font/title_font); its CJK helpers (cn_money, labels) are not called by card UI code.
files.scripts/core/appraise.gd: C12 preloads it only for circle fitting and part rects; TOOL_CN / hit_note / miss_note text is never shown (spot_panel.gd uses CardText).
files.scripts/core/flaw_render.gd: Pixel flaw rendering only; the CJK is in a comment-free constant never shown to the player.
files.scripts/town/settings.gd: Read/written by C16 for the four shared keys; TEXT_SPEEDS labels are not displayed by the card settings panel (it uses c16.* ui keys).
files.scripts/sim/pressure_model.gd: Report strings for the legacy town log; never displayed in the card UI.
files.scripts/sim/world_wheel.gd: Report strings for the legacy town log; never displayed in the card UI.
files.data/town/item_templates.json: Legacy item names and texts; the card build shows item text only from data/cards/text/items.text.json (human), templates are read for prices, parts and sprites.
files.data/cast.json: Legacy names; person names are shown only from data/cards/text/persons.text.json (human); cast.json is read for person ids only.
